name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
summary: Tommy Joe Stonefield is a young farmer caught in a bitter family rivalry in the heart of Elwynn Forest. Deeply in love with Maybell Maclure, he must rely on quiet riverbanks and secret messages to keep their romance hidden from their feuding kin.

sections.title: A Star-Crossed Feud
sections.body: Standing by the riverbank just west of the Stonefield Farm, Tommy Joe Stonefield spends his days looking across the water toward the Maclure homestead. The Stonefields and Maclures have harbored bad blood for years, clashing over land, pride, and petty farmyard squabbles. Yet despite the hostility preached by his elders, Tommy Joe has fallen head over heels for Maybell Maclure. Unable to meet openly without sparking outrage from both households, he depends on trusted intermediaries and his sympathetic grandmother, Gramma Stonefield, to exchange secret notes and tokens of affection.

faq.answer: He is a young human living on the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest. He is secretly in love with Maybell Maclure, the daughter of his family's bitter rivals.

faq.q: Where can I find Tommy Joe Stonefield?
faq.answer: Tommy Joe stands along the riverbank west of the Stonefield Farm, gazing across the water toward the Maclure farmstead where Maybell lives.

faq.q: Why are the Stonefields and Maclures fighting?
aliases: why do they hate each other
faq.answer: No one says what started it. The two farming families have simply kept up a long, bitter feud, and neither side wants its young ones associating with the other.

faq.q: Who helps Tommy Joe and Maybell meet?
faq.answer: Gramma Stonefield is aware of their affection and helps facilitate their secret courtship, using outside travelers to carry discreet messages between Tommy Joe and Maybell.

angles.text: For Alliance adventurers exploring southern Elwynn, Tommy Joe's secret romance is a humble reminder of the quiet, personal lives continuing in the shadow of regional banditry and political unrest.
